# Shared hosting-ingress Traefik metrics entrypoint scrape — one
# customer-facing entrypoint ("web"), one backend service with two servers
# (one down), a retry, and the daemon's own self-scrapes of "metrics"
# (nonzero, to prove they never leak into the normalized customer-traffic
# fields).
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_requests_total How many HTTP requests processed on an entrypoint, partitioned by status code, protocol, and method.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_requests_total counter
traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 90
traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 10
traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http"} 5000
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds How long it took to process the request on an entrypoint.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds histogram
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="0.1"} 60
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="0.5"} 85
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="1"} 88
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="5"} 90
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="+Inf"} 90
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_sum{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 9.0
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_count{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 90
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="0.1"} 8
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="0.5"} 10
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="1"} 10
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="5"} 10
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="+Inf"} 10
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_sum{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 1.0
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_count{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 10
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http",le="0.1"} 5000
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http",le="+Inf"} 5000
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_sum{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http"} 50.0
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_count{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http"} 5000
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total The total size of requests in bytes handled by an entrypoint.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total counter
traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 45000
traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 2000
traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http"} 900000
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total The total size of responses in bytes handled by an entrypoint.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total counter
traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 500000
traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total{code="404",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 4000
traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total{code="200",entrypoint="metrics",method="GET",protocol="http"} 7000000
# HELP traefik_open_connections How many open connections exist, by entrypoint and protocol.
# TYPE traefik_open_connections gauge
traefik_open_connections{entrypoint="web",protocol="TCP"} 2
traefik_open_connections{entrypoint="web",protocol="UDP"} 1
traefik_open_connections{entrypoint="metrics",protocol="TCP"} 9
# HELP traefik_service_retries_total How many request retries happened on a service.
# TYPE traefik_service_retries_total counter
traefik_service_retries_total{service="hosting-svc@docker"} 4
# HELP traefik_service_server_up Backend server up status.
# TYPE traefik_service_server_up gauge
traefik_service_server_up{service="hosting-svc@docker",url="http://172.18.0.2:80"} 1
traefik_service_server_up{service="hosting-svc@docker",url="http://172.18.0.3:80"} 0
